note: USFS Chattahoochee NF, Conasauga RD, on the South Fork of the Jacks River. Access is 15+ mi of steep, narrow, winding gravel road whose condition changes with the weather; FS 64 is closed west of the campground January-March, so it is reached only from Blue Ridge then. Also accommodates horses/mules (corrals and horse-trailer parking at the back). Nearest gas and store 16 mi away in Blue Ridge; cell service very limited. --Claude
